name: minimum-wire-gauge-power
description: Power wires must not be thinner than a gauge you choose. The number in this example is made up for the documentation; put the value of your own standard in its place.

thinnest_awg.source: example value for the documentation, not a requirement of any standard
thinnest_awg.description: The thinnest wire (largest AWG number) allowed for power.

rules.title: Minimum wire gauge for power
rules.message: Wire {object} ({wire.signal}) is AWG {actual}, thinner than the AWG {limit} allowed for power
rules.why: A thin wire in a power line heats up and drops more voltage than the line was planned for.
rules.how: Choose a gauge with a number at or below the limit (a thicker wire) for this wire.
